title: Cultures Around Us Worksheets | K–2nd Social Studies Practice with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Standards aligned: C3 D2.Geo.6.K-2

Give your learners extra practice with Cultures Around Us! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Cultures Around Us
  • Part of Culture or Not?
  • Hello Around the World
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Cultures Around Us, Part of Culture or Not?, Hello Around the World), so children can play, then print and practice
